proposed_metadata.title: GDTCR: Benchmarking single-CDR3 partner recovery in human gamma-delta T-cell receptors under controlled exposure protocols
proposed_metadata.description: Author-review source, original sequence/contig/database input exports, cleaned inputs, frozen splits, code snapshots, task manifests, reference analyses, manuscript and figure assets for the GDTCR controlled recorded-partner recovery benchmark. Recorded pairing is not biological function. Truth-containing retrieval is distinct from free generation. This draft precedes author review and is not an approved journal submission. Initialization weights are supplied as a separate checksum-verified asset; downstream training and full free-draw arrays are reproducible from the fixed task graph, not all embedded in this archive. No license or ethics determination has been inferred.
